name: Protopasta HTPLA
filament_notes:
Covers Premium HTPLA v3, High Temp PLA v2 and the color lines (opaque, translucent, metallic, glitter, fluorescent, multicolor, glow) plus Quantum Dot HTPLA.
Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate. This profile uses 220C with a 12 mm3/s cap - raise toward 240C when printing near the cap. Quantum Dot TDS: 220-240C nozzle, 55-65C bed.
Heat treating (after printing): TDS says 95-110C for 10+ minutes; the HTPLA FAQ says 95-120C, usually about 10 minutes, on a flat wood or silicone surface. Parts shrink, so scale them up in the slicer first. Heat-treated HTPLA holds its shape to roughly 140-155C.
Prusa MK2/MK3 with the stock heatbreak: Proto-Pasta says 235-240C can help avoid jams at the heatbreak ledge, but recommends a different hotend as the better fix.
